purpose: Re-weight v30's LIRF blend on the lirf_nonpop_unmatched scope only (v9 / LIRF tree table ens_v22_lirf_q / LIRF context network ens_ctx_lirf). July 2026 LIRF is ADS-B-dark, so about 15.5k ranking rows sit in this scope; January 2025 (no LIRF coverage before May 2025) is the development month closest to that regime. No model is fitted; every other row keeps v30's recipe.

prior_context.note: Declared after a scratch leave-one-month-out screen by the parallel session, before any score of the fixed candidates below.
prior_context.screen_input: runs/share_scope/lirf_components.parquet (LIRF rows of the four recipe months: label, v9, ens_v22_lirf_q, ens_ctx_lirf, scope flags, day)
prior_context.screen_result: on lirf_nonpop_unmatched rows, weights chosen on three months and scored on the held-out month picked net 0.55-0.70 / tree 0 / v9 0.30-0.45; pooled best 0.60/0.00/0.40; held-out month RMSE change against lctx_b100_up -0.005/-0.024/-0.038/-0.029% (Jan/Jul/Nov/Dec). Re-tuning the matched scope hurt held-out months, so it is kept.
prior_context.known_scores_before_declaration: only the screen above; none of the recipe-level candidate scores below

control.name: v30
control.recipe: committee mix c_e24x32_e32h (configs/adsb_ctx_v5.json: 0.25 ens_ctx_e24 + 0.25 ens_ctx_e24b + 0.5 ens_ctx_e32 at share 0.75) + round B's LIRF blends lctx_b100_up (configs/adsb_ctx_lirf_v1.json)
control.reproduction: the control must reproduce, to 1e-9 s per row and in RMSE, v30's development rows of runs/error_map/dev_rows.parquet (tools/v30_error_map.py), whose own rebuild checked v28, c_e24x32_e32h with v25's LIRF blends and v27 + lctx_b100_up against their recorded development RMSE; those three checks are repeated here

candidate_semantics: each candidate replaces only the lirf_nonpop_unmatched (net, tree, v9) weights of the control; lirf_nonpop_matched stays 0.40/0.45/0.15, the LIRF network stays ens_ctx_lirf, the committee mix, residual stage, v9, floor and every non-LIRF or LIRF-population row are v30's. Blends through tools/run_adsb_nn2_dev.lirf_blends (outer weight tree + net, table the normalised tree/net mix).
selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v30. The rule of adsb_nn/nn2 and round B, unchanged.
ship: If a candidate is selected: recompute the recipe on the final-file runner's dry run (runs/final_dryrun/run, its residual table, tree tables and network ensembles) with only the unmatched LIRF weights changed, take the delta against the dry run's v30, add it to v31's floats (v30 float detail + 0.5 x the LFPG EOBT_1 effect, tools/export_lfpg_eobt_blend.py), floor -12, export as the next version via the standard contract, verify (delta non-zero only on lirf_nonpop_unmatched rows), audit. Upload only on the user's decision.
